probe.request: One tiny chat request after reset, then once every 900 seconds until success
probe.before_reset_inference: Forbidden; preparation and dry-run send zero Devin requests

thinking_policy: Choose max when listed, otherwise highest listed level. none-available only when the catalog lists no levels. Failed transmission or identity verification excludes the model, never downgrades it.
repetition_policy: Three independent Devin attempts per verified model. Existing Go results are a separate route and never enter Devin best-of-three.

intentional_changes: shared default Boat packing matching Google

qualification_policy: Every requested catalog model is qualified at its frozen maximum tier. Selection records and excludes blocked identities or controls. Controller execution errors, incomplete qualification output, compile errors and doctor errors stop the chain before launch.
quota_policy: Quota failures remain infrastructure failures under the existing campaign policy; no model score penalty and no cross-route mixing. The initial quota gate expires after six hours. Later quota failures stop the campaign for operator-managed rerun under frozen conditions.
scoring: Launcher sets KEYGEN_FT2_ANALYSIS and LD_LIBRARY_PATH on Ashburn.
host_safety: No Paris changes; Minecraft remains stopped; no media transferred to local workspace. Dedicated Ashburn bridge removes laptop/tunnel dependence.
restart_policy: Exclusive lock prevents duplicate chains. Terminal FAILED or COMPLETED status requires explicit operator inspection before restarting. Detached scheduler survives SSH disconnect, not controller reboot.
risks: Reset time is user-estimated; 15-minute polling covers delays up to six hours
Subscription quota may not cover all models and repetitions
Boat balance may stop later attempts; packing reduces but does not eliminate credit use
Live model identity and maximum-thinking readiness cannot be established before reset
Controller reboot stops the detached chain
